content.short: L2BEAT is an analytics and research site focused on Ethereum layer 2 scaling data and related security metrics.
content.description: L2BEAT is an analytics and research site focused on Ethereum layer 2 scaling data. It helps users gauge the activity and health of Layer 2 protocols by presenting key metrics for each project. In addition to general activity indicators, L2BEAT places particular emphasis on security metrics, offering transparent insights into the security posture of different L2 solutions and how they compare. L2BEAT is not-for-profit and relies on donations from its users to support the platform, fund ongoing development, and grow its offerings for the community.
